title: Installation Coordination Note: Cancelled Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts and Special Order Storage Charges
content:
Where the customer's Ridgeline Installation Services contract at the delivery address of a Ridgeline Special Order Services order was cancelled, the storage charge on that order, in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent, carries a quoted-installation share.

**Clause.** The quoted-installation share depends on the customer's Ridgeline Installation Services contract at the delivery address: a cancelled contract on which the customer made payments gives a share of 0.8; a cancelled contract with no payments gives 0.9; otherwise the share is 1.

The storage charge is multiplied by the quoted-installation share in the same product as the days of storage billed and the storage fee per day, before that product is rounded to the nearest cent and held to the storage cap; the share itself is never rounded.

## Records read

- The installation contract whose job address is the delivery address of the special order, and its status.
- The payment lines received on that contract; any payment received on it counts as payments made.

## Share by contract record

| Contract at the delivery address | Payments received on that contract | Share |
|---|---|---|
| cancelled | one or more | 0.8 |
| cancelled | none | 0.9 |
| any other status | any | 1 |
| no contract at that address | — | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical 15 billable days at 5.00 a day)

| Contract at the delivery address | Charge |
|---|---|
| cancelled after a deposit was paid on it | 60.00 |
| cancelled with nothing paid | 67.50 |
| scheduled | 75.00 |
